items.title: August 2026 apps release notes
items.metaDescription: August connects inventory, transfers, integrations, and exception work across HotWax Commerce, with clearer controls and stronger operational visibility.

items.title: HotWax Commerce turns Company into an integration control center
items.metaDescription: Company brings Shopify, NetSuite, carrier, Unigate, app-version, and batch-order controls into one HotWax Commerce administration workspace.

items.title: HotWax Commerce connects transfer-order creation, reservation, fulfillment, and receipt
items.metaDescription: HotWax Commerce connects transfer creation, warehouse inventory commitments, and NetSuite lifecycle imports to keep transfer stock out of online availability.

items.title: HotWax Commerce connects Cycle Count creation with traceable variance decisions
items.metaDescription: Cycle Count adds count creation for store and admin teams, better review search, and a reusable history of inventory variance decisions.

items.title: HotWax Commerce adds a durable event ledger for Shopify inventory publishing
items.metaDescription: HotWax Commerce records inventory events in a durable ledger, batches Shopify updates safely, and exposes the publishing flow in Company.

items.title: HotWax Commerce brings NetSuite subsidiary mapping into Company
items.metaDescription: HotWax Commerce helps retailers manage operating companies and maintain subsidiary IDs for configured NetSuite order exports in Company.

items.title: HotWax Commerce keeps Shopify fulfillment locations and OMS allocations aligned
items.metaDescription: HotWax Commerce reconciles Shopify fulfillment-location changes with OMS allocations while protecting inventory accuracy and preventing sync loops.
